source: User photographs of Português a Valer 3 glossary, pages 192, 194, 196, 198 and 200
normalization_notes: Assistant visual transcription of the Portuguese and English glossary columns only. German, Spanish, French, Chinese and internal lesson-page reference columns were not transcribed.

Keep printed articles, expressions and source English in rows. Remove article annotations from vocabulary entries; split expressions and pronominal clitics into individual words, keeping independent component translations.
Keep bem-sucedido as a lexical hyphenated compound. Lowercase and NFC-normalize words. Do not reduce other inflected forms to lemmas.
Book level B1 is user-supplied metadata; individual CEFR levels are assistant estimates, and may differ from B1.
Topic and grammatical groups only; book title and page numbers remain metadata. No database writes performed.
Two printed destaque rows are preserved and merged into one vocabulary entry with both senses.
Unclear internal reference digits were intentionally not guessed. Source photos are backed up for later inspection.
Estória is retained as the printed literary spelling; it is not silently changed to história. Cacimbo and bué are retained with regional/colloquial context in notes.
extraction_method: Assistant visual transcription of supplied photographs
